newsitem.title: UK: S&P affirms Siebe long, short-term ratings.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms Siebe long, short-term ratings.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Monday it had assigned an A plus rating to the $250 million senior unsecured global notes of Siebe Plc.
"The outlook is stable," S&P said in a statement.
S&P also said it affirmed Siebe's A plus long-term and A1 short-term ratings.
S&P said the ratings reflected UK-based Siebe's position as a leading diversified engineering group, and a strong financial profile.

"Group sales ... are well diversified both geographically and by end-user industry," S&P said. "This, and the fact that the group is exposed to all stages of the economic cycle, helps to mitigate the cyclicality normally associated with the engineering sector."
"Growth opportunities stem from Siebe's strong presence in developing economies, and from the gradual shift towards electronic and software-based products, which favors the group," it added.
S&P said organic growth has been supplemented by a series of sizable acquisitions over the last 10 years to strengthen the group's position in its core markets.
Most of these acquisitions had been financed with equity, allowing Siebe to maintain a conservative financial profile.
S&P said that the largest of Siebe's recent acquisitions, that of Unitech Plc UTC.L, gives Siebe a leading position in the fast-growing electronic power controls market.

"Though the acquisition of Unitech was a sizable one, its operations make a good strategic fit with the group, and it was conservatively financed," it said. "Siebe is expected to maintain its strong financial profile whilst continuing to enjoy above average growth rates."
